The Chhattisgarh Staff Selection Board (CGSSB), Raipur has released the final answer key and result for four separate written recruitment examinations on 23 September 2026 (23.09.2026). These results cover the Firemen (NSF26), Tracer Civil (WRDT26), Laboratory Attendant (PSLA26), and Junior Judicial Assistant (HJJA25) recruitment exams. This article summarizes the official notifications, important dates, and how candidates can check their individual results.

  • PSLA26 (Laboratory Attendant) written exam: 26.07.2026

Candidates can use the direct links below to download the CGSSB Final Answer Key and Result 2026 for Fireman, Tracer (Civil), Laboratory Attendant, and Junior Judicial Assistant examinations from the official website.

How to Check Your CGSSB Result

  1. Visit the official CGSSB website: vyapamcg.cgstate.gov.in or cgssb.cgstate.gov.in.
  2. Log in to your candidate profile using your registered credentials.
  3. Open the result section for your respective exam (NSF26, WRDT26, PSLA26, or HJJA25).
  4. View and download your individual result.

According to the official notices, results of all candidates are available on the CGSSB website, and candidates must log in to their own profile to view their individual result - results are not published as a single combined list on these notices.

How to Check IBPS PO Prelims Result 2026

The direct result link is active on the official IBPS portal. Candidates can also follow these steps from the ibps.in homepage:

Step Procedure
1 Visit the official IBPS website, ibps.in
2 Click on the "CRP PO/MT-XVI" section on the homepage
3 Open the "Preliminary Exam Result" link
4 Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password/Date of Birth
5 Submit the details to view your qualifying status
6 Download the result PDF and take a printout for future use

Details Mentioned on the IBPS PO Prelims Scorecard 2026

The scorecard released along with the result is expected to contain the following details:

  • Candidate's name
  • Roll number and registration number
  • Date of birth
  • Category
  • Section-wise marks secured
  • Total/aggregate marks
  • Minimum qualifying marks (category-wise)
  • Qualifying status (Qualified / Not Qualified)

Expected Cut-Off for IBPS PO Prelims 2026

Based on candidate feedback and exam-analysis trends, the expected cut-off range is as follows. These figures are explicitly expected, not official, since IBPS has not released a separate cut-off notice alongside the result.

Category Expected Cut-Off (out of 100)

OBC 50–53
EWS 50–52
SC 45–49
ST 40–43

What Happens After the IBPS PO Prelims Result 2026?

Candidates who qualify the Prelims will proceed through the following stages:

What's Next After the AFCAT Result 2026?

Candidates who qualify in the AFCAT 02/2026 written exam move to the next stage of selection:

  • No Attempt Limit: There is no cap on the number of AFCAT attempts, subject to meeting the age criteria for each cycle.
  • Review Your Scorecard: Check section-wise marks to identify weaker areas to focus on.
  • Practice: Solve previous years' AFCAT papers and take mock tests to improve speed and accuracy.

  • Keep your AFCAT User ID and Password safe for logging in to check the result and, later, the AFSB call letter.

  • Cross-check the domain name in your browser address bar before entering personal details.
  • Download and save a copy of the score card for future reference, as it may be required at later stages of recruitment.
  • In case of login errors, this can occur due to incorrect details, heavy website traffic, or a temporary technical issue — wait and retry rather than repeatedly submitting incorrect information.
  • Report any factual error on your score card to SBI through the official grievance/contact channel rather than assuming it will self-correct.

SBI PO Mains Exam 2026: Next Step

Candidates shortlisted through the SBI PO Prelims Result 2026 will appear for the SBI PO Mains Examination scheduled on 12th September 2026. The Mains exam includes both an objective test and a descriptive paper, with negative marking of 0.25 marks per wrong answer applicable to the objective section only. The SBI PO Mains Admit Card release date is Not Available Officially at the time of this update. Shortlisted candidates are advised to use their Prelims score card to identify weaker sections and focus preparation accordingly on reasoning, data analysis, English language, general/economy/banking awareness, and descriptive writing.

The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the notification for the Common Recruitment Process for Regional Rural Banks, 15th cycle (CRP RRBs-XV), inviting online applications for Group "A" Officer (Scale-I, II & III) and Group "B" Office Assistant (Multipurpose) posts across 28 Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) in India. IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026 online registration opens on 1 September 2026 and closes on 27 September 2026.

Quick answer: IBPS is recruiting for Officer Scale-I, II (seven specialisations), III, and Office Assistant (Multipurpose) posts, with an indicative 13,706 vacancies spread across 28 RRBs covering nearly every state and union territory of India. Graduates in any discipline (with specific additional qualifications for certain Officer Scale-II specialist roles) between 18 and 40 years of age (depending on the post) can apply online only, from 1 September 2026 to 27 September 2026, at the official IBPS website, www.ibps.in.

Particulars Details
Recruiting Body Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS), on behalf of 28 Regional Rural Banks (RRBs)
Recruitment Name Common Recruitment Process for RRBs (CRP RRBs-XV)

Application Mode Online only

Official Website www.ibps.in

Activity Tentative Schedule
Online registration of application 01.09.2026 to 21.09.2026

Extended Online Registration of Applications & Payment of Fees/Intimation Charges 01.09.2026 to 27.09.2026

IBPS RRB Vacancy 2026 - Post-Wise Details

IBPS has released indicative, RRB-wise and category-wise vacancies for each post in Annexure-I of the notification. The notification itself does not print a single consolidated grand-total figure; the totals below are computed by summing the individual state/RRB-wise tables for each post category. One participating bank, Tripura Gramin Bank, has reported "NR" (Not Reported) against every post, so it is excluded from these computed totals and the true final vacancy count will be higher once that figure is released.

Vacancies are spread across all 28 participating RRBs, covering states such as Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Gujarat, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, and others. Candidates can check the RRB-wise, category-wise (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/General) breakup for their state directly in Annexure-I of the official notification, since a state/category-level reproduction is too extensive for this summary.

IBPS RRB Eligibility Criteria & Qualification

Nationality: a candidate must be a citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who arrived before 1 January 1962 intending to settle permanently in India, or a person of Indian origin migrated from certain specified countries with an eligibility certificate from the Government of India.

Educational qualification (as on the last date of online registration, i.e. 21.09.2026) varies by post:

Post Essential Educational Qualification Post-Qualification Experience
Office Assistant (Multipurpose) Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university or equivalent; proficiency in the local language prescribed by the participating RRB; working knowledge of computers is desirable Not required
Officer Scale-I (Assistant Manager) Bachelor's degree in any discipline; preference to candidates with a degree in Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, Animal Husbandry, Veterinary Science, Agricultural Engineering, Pisciculture, Agricultural Marketing and Cooperation, IT, Management, Law, Economics or Accountancy; local language proficiency required Not required
Officer Scale-II - General Banking Officer Bachelor's degree in any discipline with minimum 50% aggregate marks; preference to specified subject backgrounds 2 years as an officer in a bank or financial institution
Officer Scale-II - Information Technology Officer Bachelor's degree in Electronics/Communication/Computer Science/IT or equivalent, minimum 50% aggregate marks 1 year in the relevant field
Officer Scale-II - Chartered Accountant Certified Associate of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India 1 year as a Chartered Accountant
Officer Scale-II - Law Officer Degree in Law from a recognised university, minimum 50% aggregate marks 2 years as an advocate, or as a Law Officer in a bank/financial institution
Officer Scale-II - Treasury Manager Chartered Accountant, or MBA in Finance from a recognised university/institution 1 year in the relevant field
Officer Scale-II - Marketing Officer MBA in Marketing from a recognised university 1 year in the relevant field
Officer Scale-II - Agricultural Officer Bachelor's degree in Agriculture/Horticulture/Dairy/Animal Husbandry/Forestry/Veterinary Science/Agricultural Engineering/Pisciculture, minimum 50% aggregate marks 2 years in the relevant field
Officer Scale-III (Senior Manager) Bachelor's degree in any discipline, minimum 50% aggregate marks; preference to specified subject backgrounds Minimum 5 years as an officer in a bank or financial institution

Candidates awarded CGPA/OGPA must convert it to a percentage as per their university's own conversion criteria, and the result for the qualifying degree must have been declared on or before 27.09.2026.

IBPS RRB Age Limit

Age is reckoned as on 01.09.2026.

Post Age Limit
Office Assistant (Multipurpose) 18 to 28 years
Officer Scale-I (Assistant Manager) Above 18, below 30 years
Officer Scale-II (Manager) Above 21, below 32 years
Officer Scale-III (Senior Manager) Above 21, below 40 years

Age relaxation is available as follows: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (non-creamy layer), 10 years for Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD), and additional relaxation for Ex-Servicemen and (for Office Assistant only) widows, divorced women, and women legally separated from their husbands who have not remarried. Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC is cumulative with only one other applicable category.

Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

Salary: Not specified in the notification.

Exam pattern: The online examination structure differs by post and stage.

Post Stage Sections Total Marks Duration

Office Assistant / Officer Scale-I Main Reasoning, Computer Knowledge, General Awareness, English/Hindi Language, Numerical Ability/Quantitative Aptitude 200 120 minutes
Officer Scale-III (Single-level exam) Single Reasoning, Computer Knowledge, Financial Awareness, English/Hindi Language, Quantitative Aptitude & Data Interpretation 200 120 minutes

There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in the objective tests; unattempted questions are not penalised. Officer Scale-II candidates sit for a single-level examination (structure not itemised separately in the notification excerpt reviewed here beyond the general pattern above).

Also read: IBPS RRB Clerk Exam Pattern and Syllabus 2026: Download PDF Here

IBPS RRB Selection Process

  • Office Assistant (Multipurpose): Preliminary Exam → Main Exam → Provisional Allotment (based on Main Exam marks and actual vacancies reported by the RRB).
  • Officer Scale-I: Preliminary Exam → Main Exam → Common Interview → Provisional Allotment.
  • Officer Scale-II & III: Single-level online exam → Common Interview → Provisional Allotment.
  • Interview is out of 100 marks; minimum qualifying marks are 40% (35% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates).
  • The relative weightage for Officer posts is 80% online exam and 20% interview.
  • Interviews for Officer posts are coordinated by the Nodal Regional Rural Bank with the assistance of NABARD and IBPS.

How to Apply for IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026

  2. Click "CLICK HERE TO APPLY ONLINE FOR CRP-RRBs-OFFICERS (Scale-I, II and III)" or "CLICK HERE TO APPLY ONLINE FOR CRP-RRBs-OFFICE ASSISTANTS (Multipurpose)", as applicable.

  8. Take a printout of the final submitted application form for future reference.

SSC will conduct an Open Competitive Examination to fill posts of Sub-Inspector (GD) in CAPFs, Sub-Inspector (Executive) in Delhi Police (Male/Female), and Sub-Inspector (Fire) in CISF (Male). The notice will be uploaded on the SSC website (https://ssc.gov.in) on 10.09.2026.

A higher qualification (B.Tech/M.Tech) in relevant fields is treated as value addition, subject to the basic diploma being held.

For the post of SI in Delhi Police, male candidates must possess a valid Driving License for LMV (Motorcycle and Car) on the date fixed for the Physical Endurance and Measurement Test (PE&MT). Male candidates without a valid LMV licence are eligible only for SI posts in CAPFs, not Delhi Police.

  • Women candidates and candidates belonging to SC, ST and Ex-Servicemen (eligible for reservation) are exempted from fee payment.
  • Fee can be paid only through online modes: BHIM UPI, Net Banking, Visa, MasterCard, Maestro, or RuPay Debit card.
  • Fee payment closes 01.10.2026 (23:00 hrs); no other mode of payment is permitted.
  • Fee once paid is non-refundable and non-adjustable against any other examination.
  • Application Form Correction Window (08.10.2026 to 10.10.2026) charges: ₹200 for the first correction, ₹500 for the second correction - applicable to all candidates regardless of gender/category.

SSC SI CAPF Recruitment 2026 Selection Process / Scheme of Examination

The examination consists of four mandatory stages: Paper-I, Physical Standard Test (PST) / Physical Endurance Test (PET), Paper-II, and Detailed Medical Examination (DME).

Paper-I

Part Subject No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration

II General Knowledge and General Awareness 25 25
III Quantitative Aptitude 25 25
IV English Comprehension 25 25

Paper-II

Part Subject No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration
I General Intelligence and Reasoning 20 40 1 Hour (sectional timer of 20 minutes per part)
II General Knowledge and General Awareness 20 40
III Quantitative Aptitude 20 40
IV English Comprehension 100 200 1 Hour

Questions in both papers are Objective Multiple Choice Type, set in Hindi and English (Parts I–III). Negative marking: 0.25 marks per wrong answer in Paper-I, 0.50 marks per wrong answer in Paper-II. Difficulty level of Paper-II is higher than Paper-I. NCC Certificate holders get bonus marks: 5% (NCC 'C'), 3% (NCC 'B'), 2% (NCC 'A') of maximum marks in each paper, as on the closing date of application.

Physical Standard Test (PST) – Height & Chest Norms

Height and chest requirements vary by post (SI Delhi Police / SI CAPFs / SI Fire CISF) and candidate category (general, hill areas, Scheduled Tribes, Gorkha, North-Eastern States, etc.), ranging from 154 cm to 170 cm for height depending on category and gender. Female candidates have no minimum chest measurement requirement. Weight must correspond to height for all posts. PST/PET is qualifying/eliminating in nature and does not carry marks. Relaxation in height/chest is permitted only on production of the prescribed competent-authority certificate.

Event Male Female

Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET but must clear the written tests, physical standards and medical standards prescribed for direct recruits.

Medical Examination

All candidates who qualify Paper-II undergo a Detailed Medical Examination (DME) by CAPF Medical Officers. A Review Medical Examination (RME) is conducted for candidates found unfit in DME, preferably the next day; the decision of the Review Medical Board is final. DME/RME is mandatory but qualifying in nature.

Document Verification

Document Verification is conducted by the CAPFs before final result declaration, preferably alongside the DME/RME stage. Candidates must bring two passport-size colour photographs, one original valid Photo ID proof, and originals plus copies of: Matriculation/Secondary Certificate, Educational Qualification Certificate, equivalence order/letter (if applicable), Caste/Category Certificate (if reserved category), Driving Licence (for Delhi Police male candidates), and Ex-Servicemen undertaking/certificates (if applicable).

SSC SI CAPF Recruitment 2026 Indicative Syllabus

  • General Intelligence and Reasoning: Analogies, similarities/differences, space visualization, problem solving, coding-decoding, number/figural series, syllogistic reasoning, Venn diagrams, critical thinking, etc.
  • General Knowledge and General Awareness: Current events, History, Culture, Geography, Economic Scene, General Polity, Indian Constitution, Scientific Research.
  • Quantitative Aptitude: Number systems, percentage, ratio, averages, interest, profit & loss, time & work, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, mensuration, data interpretation (graphs, histograms, pie charts).
  • English Comprehension: Error recognition, fill in the blanks, vocabulary, spellings, grammar, sentence structure, synonyms, antonyms, idioms, comprehension.

SSC CPO Syllabus 2026

How to Apply for SSC SI CAPF Recruitment 2026

  1. Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) on the SSC website, https://ssc.gov.in. OTR generated on the old website (ssc.nic.in) will not work on the new website.
  2. Log in using your Registration Number and Password, then click 'Apply' against the SSC SI in Delhi Police and CAPFs Examination, 2026.
  3. Fill in the Online Application Form either on the SSC website or via the 'mySSC' mobile application (available on Store).
  4. Candidates are advised to opt for Aadhaar-Based Authentication while completing OTR, which exempts them from photo/signature rejection on format grounds and from producing colour photographs/photo-ID at the exam venue.
  5. Capture a live photograph as prompted by the application (no pre-existing photo upload) with good light, plain background, no cap/mask/glasses.
  6. Upload scanned signature in JPEG format (10–20 KB, approx. 6.0 cm width x 2.0 cm height).
  7. Use the Preview/Print option to check all details before final submission.
  8. Pay the application fee of ₹100 online (if not exempted) through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, Visa, MasterCard, Maestro or RuPay Debit card.
  9. Submit the application before 30.09.2026 (23:00 hrs) and complete fee payment before 01.10.2026 (23:00 hrs).

SSC SI CAPF Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • A candidate must be a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal, or a subject of Bhutan.
  • The Commission neither collects vacancies nor allocates candidates state-wise, region-wise, zone-wise or city-wise for this examination.
  • Candidates should submit applications well before the closing date to avoid last-minute website load issues; SSC is not responsible for failure to submit due to such reasons.
  • Applications with incomplete fee payment status will be summarily rejected.
  • After the correction window closes, no further change/correction/modification will be allowed under any circumstances.
  • Candidates have the option to choose three examination centres (in order of priority) within the same SSC region; no request for centre change will be entertained later.
  • Marks in multi-shift Computer Based Examinations will be normalized as per the Commission's published procedure.
  • There is no provision for re-evaluation/re-checking of scores.
  • Success in the examination confers no right to appointment unless the Commission is satisfied, after such enquiry as considered necessary, that the candidate is suitable in all respects.
  • Candidates should retain their application forms and exam-related documents for at least 3 years for future reference.
  • Information furnished in the application will be verified against original documents during Document Verification; false information will lead to summary rejection of candidature.
  • Various penalties (ranging from 1 to 7 years' debarment) apply for unfair means, impersonation, misbehaviour, or possession of prohibited devices during the examination - full details are in the official notice.

The Indian Coast Guard Group C selection process will include the following stages:

  1. Scrutiny of applications
  2. Shortlisting of eligible candidates

UIIC AO Recruitment 2026 Overview

Particulars Details
Recruiting Organisation United India Insurance Company Limited (UIIC), a Government of India Undertaking

Application Start Date 8th September 2026
Last Date to Apply Online 28th September 2026

Official Website uiic.co.in

Event Date
Online Registration Commences 8th September 2026
Last Date of Online Registration 28th September 2026
Last Date for Payment of Application Fee/Service Charges 28th September 2026

Tier I: Preliminary Examination (Online Objective Test) 22nd October 2026 (tentative)
Tier II: Main Examination (Online Objective Test + Descriptive Test) 30th November 2026 (tentative)

UIIC AO Vacancy Details

UIIC has announced 225 provisional vacancies for Administrative Officer (Scale I) across two disciplines. The category-wise breakup, including the 4% horizontal reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), is given below. Note that these numbers are provisional and may vary as per the notification.

S. No. Post Name No. of Posts
1 Administrative Officer – Generalists 200 (UR-68, OBC-62, EWS-22, SC-30, ST-18; PwBD horizontal: VI-2, HI-2, OC-4, MD/ID-3)
2 Administrative Officer – Hindi Officers 25 (UR-11, OBC-7, EWS-2, SC-4, ST-1; PwBD horizontal: VI-1)

A candidate can apply for either Generalists or Hindi Officers, but not both. Multiple registrations or appearances will lead to cancellation of candidature. Candidates currently serving as Administrative Officers (Scale-I) in UIIC are not eligible to apply.

Also Read: Bank of Baroda SO Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 1100 Wealth Executive, Credit Analyst Posts

UIIC AO Eligibility Criteria

Candidates applying for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026 must satisfy the Nationality/Citizenship condition as on the date of application. A candidate must be either a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal, a subject of Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1st January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia, or Vietnam with the intention of permanently settling in India. Candidates in the last four categories must hold an eligibility certificate issued by the Government of India.

UIIC AO Qualification

The minimum educational qualification must have been obtained on or before 30.06.2026 from a recognised university or institute, approved by UGC/AICTE, through the 10+2+3 pattern or an equivalent system. Working knowledge of computers is mandatory for all candidates.

Discipline Minimum Educational Qualification
Generalists Graduate or Postgraduate degree in any discipline (including Engineering, Arts, Science, Commerce, Agriculture, Data Science, etc.) from a recognised university with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD category)
Hindi Officers Master’s Degree from a recognised university with Hindi and English in any of the specified combinations (as compulsory/elective subject or medium of examination) at the degree level, with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD category)

Where only CGPA/OGPA/SGPA is awarded, candidates must produce a conversion certificate from the university; a fraction such as 59.99% will be treated as less than 60%.

UIIC AO Age Limit

As on 30.06.2026, the minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 30 years. Candidates must have been born not earlier than 30.06.1996 and not later than 30.06.2005 (both dates inclusive). Upper age relaxation is available as follows, subject to a cumulative cap of 45 years.

Category Age Relaxation
Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe 5 Years
Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 Years
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities 10 Years
Ex-servicemen (with at least 5 years military service) 5 Years
Defence personnel disabled in operations 3 Years
Widows, divorced women, and women legally separated (not remarried) 9 Years
Existing confirmed employees of Public Sector General Insurance Companies (incl. GIC & Agriculture Insurance Company of India Ltd.) 8 Years

Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

UIIC AO Application Fee

The application fee/service charges are non-refundable under any circumstances, once paid.

Category of Applicant Amount (Non-Refundable)
All applicants other than SC/ST/PwBD/permanent employees of UIIC ₹1,000/- (application fee including service charges) + GST as applicable
SC/ST/PwBD/permanent employees of UIIC Application fee: Nil. ₹250/- (service charges only) + GST as applicable

Also Read: PMBI Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Offline for 178 Pharmacist, Executive and More Posts

UIIC AO Salary

Selected candidates will draw basic pay in the scale of ₹82,485-4050(14)-139185-4390(4)-156745, along with other admissible allowances. In addition to emoluments, the Company provides Gratuity, LTS, Medical Benefits, Group Personal Accident Insurance, and National Pension System (NPS), with leased accommodation extended as per Company rules. Gross pay is approximately ₹1,10,000 per month at Metropolitan centres.

Selected candidates will serve a probation period of one year (extendable at the Company’s discretion) and must pass the non-life Licentiate Examination conducted by the Insurance Institute of India during probation. Candidates must also execute a guarantee bond to serve the Company for a minimum of five years, including the probation period; early resignation attracts liquidated damages plus a ₹35,000 onboarding and integration cost.

UIIC AO Selection Process

Selection for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026 is through a three-stage process: Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, and Interview.

  • Tier I – Preliminary Examination (Qualifying, 100 marks, 60 minutes): English Language (30 questions/30 marks), Reasoning (35/35), Quantitative Aptitude (35/35).
  • Tier II – Main Examination for Generalists: Objective Test of 250 marks (English Language, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, General Awareness with special reference to the Financial Sector, and Computer Knowledge – 200 questions, 150 minutes) followed by a Descriptive Test of 30 marks (Letter Writing and Essay, 30 minutes).
  • Tier II – Main Examination for Hindi Officers: Objective Test of 200 marks (English Language, Reasoning, Professional Knowledge of Hindi/English, General Awareness, Computer Knowledge – 150 questions, 120 minutes) followed by a Descriptive Test of 50 marks (English/Hindi essay, letter writing, and translation, 60 minutes).
  • Interview: Candidates qualifying the Main Examination are called for interview, up to three times the vacancies in the respective category/discipline.

For Generalists, the final merit list is prepared using Main Examination Objective Test marks and Interview marks in the ratio 75:25; Preliminary and Descriptive Test marks are not counted for merit. For Hindi Officers, the Main Examination (Objective + Descriptive) and Interview marks are considered in the ratio 75:25; Preliminary Examination marks are not counted for merit. There is a penalty of one-fourth of the marks assigned to a question for each wrong answer in the objective tests.

Documents Required

  • Scanned photograph (4.5cm x 3.5cm, colour, light background)
  • Scanned signature in black ink (not in capital letters)
  • Scanned left thumb impression on white paper with black or blue ink
  • Handwritten declaration in English, in the candidate’s own handwriting, as per the prescribed format
  • Valid Call Letter and original Photo Identity proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, Voter’s Card, Bank Passbook with photograph, or similar accepted ID) at the time of examination and interview
  • Category/community, age, and educational qualification certificates, as applicable, at the time of interview

Ration cards and Learner’s Driving Licences are not accepted as valid photo ID proof.

How to Apply for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the Recruitment section on the UIIC official website and click on “Apply Online”.
  2. Choose “Click here for New Registration” and enter your name, contact details, and email ID to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password.
  3. Log in and fill in the application form, using the “Save and Next” option to complete it in stages.
  4. Upload your photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration as per the specified format and size.
  5. Preview the completed application form and verify all details carefully.
  6. Click “Complete Registration” only after confirming all details are correct, as no changes are permitted afterward.
  7. Proceed to the Payment tab and pay the applicable application fee/service charges online.
  8. Click “Submit” and take a printout of the system-generated application form and payment receipt for future reference.

Also Read: RCFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 326 Graduate, Technician, Trade Apprentice Posts

Important Instructions

  • Applications must be submitted online only; no other mode of application will be accepted.
  • No change of category, discipline, or application data will be permitted after registration is complete.
  • Candidates should apply well before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.
  • The initial posting period is a minimum of five years, and requests for transfer to a preferred location will not be entertained.
  • Candidates must keep their registered email ID and mobile number active throughout the recruitment process, as all official communication will be sent there.
  • Any dispute arising from this recruitment is subject to the sole jurisdiction of the courts in Chennai.

Selection Process - CBT Pattern

Subject Questions Marks
Professional Ability 70 70
General Awareness 10 10
General Arithmetic, Intelligence & Reasoning 10 10
General Science 10 10
Total 100 100
  • Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for PwBD candidates eligible for scribe assistance).
  • Objective, multiple-choice, single-stage CBT; negative marking of 1/3 mark per wrong answer.
  • Minimum qualifying marks: UR/EWS 40%, OBC-NCL & SC 30%, ST 25% (relaxable by 2 marks for PwBD where vacancies remain unfilled).
  • Candidates equal to the number of vacancies (RRB-wise, 1:1) are called for Document Verification based on CBT merit.
  • DV is followed by a Medical Examination as per the post's medical standard (B1/C1/C2); medically unfit candidates get no alternative post.
  • Final empanelment is based on CBT merit, subject to DV and medical fitness; selection does not itself confer a right to appointment.

How to Apply

  1. Visit the unified RRB website rrb.indianrailways.gov.in and navigate to the CEN 05/2026 application link.
  2. Create an Account (or use existing RRB login credentials from earlier CENs) with a valid personal mobile number and email ID - these cannot be changed later.
  3. Authenticate identity via DigiLocker/Aadhaar for smoother verification at later stages (recommended).
  4. Choose only one RRB and give your order of preference for posts/Railway Zones within that RRB.
  5. Capture a live photograph via webcam/phone camera as instructed (no pre-existing photo uploads allowed).
  6. Upload your signature (JPG/JPEG, 30–49 KB) and, if claiming SC/ST free travel, the SC/ST certificate (PDF, under 400 KB).
  7. Choose your CBT medium of examination (English, Hindi, or one of 13 regional languages).
  8. Pay the examination fee online (net banking/card/UPI) to complete submission.
  9. Use the modification window (17–26 October 2026, ₹250 fee) if corrections are needed - except to Create-an-Account details or chosen RRB.
Important: Multiple applications to different RRBs, or more than one application to the same RRB, will lead to rejection of all applications and debarment from all future RRB/RRC examinations.

  • PwBD disability certificate (Form V/VI) and UDID, where applicable
  • Ex-Servicemen discharge/employment certificate, where applicable
  • Aadhaar card (for identity and fee refund linkage)
  • NOC from present employer, for candidates already in Government/PSU service
  • Two sets of self-attested photocopies of all original documents

Important Conditions

  • Vacancies are provisional and may increase, decrease, or become nil depending on the Railway Administration's requirements.
  • Candidates waiting for final results of the prescribed qualification are NOT eligible to apply.
  • Free Sleeper Class train travel is admissible only to SC/ST candidates (if opted) for CBT/DV/Medical Examination stages.
  • Selected candidates are ordinarily posted to the Railway/Zone of first appointment; transfer requests are not entertained until 5–10 years of service.
  • Selection by RRB does not confer any right to appointment - the RRB only recommends candidates; the Zonal Railway issues the actual offer.
  • Any use of unfair means, impersonation, or false information leads to lifetime debarment from all RRB/RRC examinations and possible legal action.
  • Banned items (mobile phones, calculators, watches, etc.) are not allowed inside the examination centre; only the e-call letter is permitted.

Post Application Opening Date Application Closing Date
Relationship Manager 23 September 2026 7 October 2026

TMB Recruitment 2026 Post-Wise Details

Post Rank/Cadre Posting Location Vacancies
Relationship Manager Manager/Assistant Manager Anywhere in India Not disclosed
Senior Relationship Manager Senior Manager/Assistant Vice President Anywhere in India Not disclosed

Educational Qualification and Experience

1. Relationship Manager

  • Candidates must have a graduation or postgraduate degree with at least 60% marks in any discipline.
  • The qualification must have been completed through the regular stream from a recognised university.
  • For the Manager rank, candidates need at least three years of relevant banking experience.
  • For the Assistant Manager rank, candidates need at least two years of relevant banking experience.
  • The relevant experience should be in sourcing or processing loans, MSME loans or retail loans.
  • No vigilance case or adverse observation from RBI or another statutory authority should be pending.

2. Senior Relationship Manager

  • Candidates must possess a graduate or postgraduate degree from a recognised university under the regular curriculum.
  • Applicants need at least five years of experience in sourcing or processing loans or MSME loans.
  • Out of the required experience, at least three years must have been completed as a Relationship Manager.
  • No vigilance case or adverse observation from the disciplinary authority, vigilance authority, RBI or another statutory authority should be pending.

Age Limit

Post Age Limit as on 31 August 2026
Relationship Manager Not more than 35 years
Senior Relationship Manager 28 to 38 years

For the Senior Relationship Manager post, the bank may relax the age limit in deserving cases.

Salary and Remuneration

Post Salary Information
Relationship Manager Salary applicable to the Manager or Assistant Manager cadre
Senior Relationship Manager Remuneration applicable to regular Senior Manager or Assistant Vice President officers

The advertisements do not provide exact salary amounts.

Application Fee

There is no application fee for any of the advertised posts.

Selection Process

The TMB selection process will involve the following stages:

  1. Scrutiny of online applications
  2. Shortlisting based on eligibility, qualification and experience
  3. Personal interview
  4. Final selection by the bank

The interview for Relationship Manager and Senior Relationship Manager may be conducted directly or through video conferencing. The interview date, time and mode will be communicated individually to shortlisted candidates.

Post-Wise Roles and Responsibilities

Relationship Manager

  • Acquire new customers and maintain existing customer relationships.
  • Promote CASA, loans, insurance, investment products and other banking services.
  • Achieve assigned sales and business targets.
  • Cross-sell banking and third-party products.
  • Ensure KYC compliance and proper documentation.
  • Conduct customer meetings, field visits and collateral verification where required.
  • Assess customer background and credit risk.
  • Support customer retention, portfolio management and recovery follow-up.

Senior Relationship Manager

  • Identify clients with substantial credit requirements.
  • Develop relationships with existing high-value customers.
  • Cross-sell and upsell credit products and banking services.
  • Achieve revenue and high-value business targets.
  • Manage the allotted credit portfolio and maintain asset quality.
  • Negotiate credit terms, interest rates and loan agreements.
  • Prepare account-performance, sales-activity and market-insight reports.
  • Participate in industry events and professional networking activities.

Documents Required

Candidates should keep scanned copies of the following documents ready:

  • SSLC or Higher Secondary marksheet/transfer certificate as proof of age
  • Degree and other educational certificates
  • Experience certificates
  • Relieving letters from previous employers
  • Latest monthly salary slip
  • Recent photograph
  • Signature

The preferred photograph dimensions are 390 × 520 pixels with a maximum file size of 120 KB. The preferred signature dimensions are 240 × 240 pixels with a maximum file size of 60 KB. Signatures written in capital letters will not be accepted. Each supporting document should generally not exceed 250 KB.

How to Apply for TMB Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Careers portal.
  2. Open the relevant recruitment advertisement.
  3. Read the eligibility requirements and instructions carefully.
  4. Click the “Apply Online” option for the required post.
  5. Register using a valid email address and mobile number.
  6. Open the activation link received through email.
  7. Log in using the registration number and password.
  8. Enter the required personal, educational and employment information.
  9. Upload the photograph, signature and supporting documents.
  10. Review the application and click the final submit button.
  11. Save or print the system-generated application form for future reference.

Important Instructions

  • Applications are accepted only through the online TMB Careers portal.
  • Candidates must provide an active email address and mobile number.
  • The applicant's name and other details must match the supporting certificates.
  • Incomplete applications or applications without the required documents may be rejected.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.
  • Relationship Manager and Senior Relationship Manager positions are transferable according to the bank's requirements.
  • The bank may reject an application without providing a reason.
  • The bank's decision regarding eligibility, interviews and final selection will be binding.

CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026 Overview

Particulars Details
Organization Directorate General, Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF), Ministry of Home Affairs

Event Date & Time
Online Application Start 12 October 2026, 9:00 AM

Correction/Modification Window 12 November 2026 to 14 November 2026

Eligible Sports Achievement Window 30 September 2024 to 30 September 2026 (2 years prior to advertisement publication)

Vacancies are tentative and may increase or decrease without notice; any change will be intimated on the CRPF recruitment website.

CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

Post Educational Qualification
HC/GD (Sports Quota) 10+2 or equivalent from a recognized Board/University recognized by the Central or State Government, or equivalent Army Qualification (for Ex-Army personnel)
CT/GD (Sports Quota) Matriculation or its equivalent from a recognized Board

Candidates who do not possess the prescribed educational qualification as on 11 November 2026 are not eligible to apply. Educational and sports qualification certificates other than from a Central/State Board must be accompanied by a Government notification declaring the equivalence of that qualification for Central Government service.

Sports Qualification – HC/GD

  • Represented the country in a recognized International Competition/Meet, with clearance from the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
  • Represented a State/UT in the National Games/Championship organized by a National Sports Federation recognized by the Department of Sports, or in National Games organized by the Indian Olympic Association, with a medal or position up to 3rd place.
  • Secured 1st or 2nd position in an individual event in Inter-University Tournaments (for team events, the team must have reached the finals) conducted by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU)/Inter University Sports Board.
  • Won Gold or Silver medal in an individual/team event at Junior National level Games/Championship/Meet organized by a recognized National Sports Federation.

Sports Qualification – CT/GD

  • Represented a State in Senior/Junior National level Games/Championships organized by a recognized National Sports Federation.
  • Represented a State School Team in National Sports/Games for Schools conducted by the All-India School Games Federation of India (SGFI), with a medal or position up to 3rd place.
  • Represented a State/UT in Khelo India University Games/Khelo India Youth Games/Khelo India Winter Games, with a medal or position up to 3rd place.
  • Represented their University in Inter-University Tournaments conducted by the Inter-University Sports Boards, in any sport/game.
Note: The sports achievement/certificate must be from within the last two years from the date of publication of this advertisement (i.e., achievements between 30 September 2024 and 30 September 2026 are eligible). Candidates awaiting results, or not in possession of the required educational/sports certificates, are not eligible and need not apply.

CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

Particular Detail
Age Limit (both posts) 18 to 23 years
Cut-off Date 1 August 2026
Date of Birth Range Not before 2 August 2003 and not after 1 August 2008

Age Relaxation (for Meritorious Sportspersons)

Category Relaxation
Unreserved (UR) 5 years
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 8 years (5+3)
SC/ST 10 years (5+5)
Ex-Servicemen (UR) 8 years (5+3), after deducting military service rendered from actual age
Ex-Servicemen (OBC) 11 years (5+3+3), after deducting military service rendered from actual age
Ex-Servicemen (SC/ST) 13 years (5+5+3), after deducting military service rendered from actual age

Candidates seeking age relaxation must submit the requisite certificate from the competent authority, in the prescribed format, when sought by the Recruitment Board; otherwise their category claim will not be entertained and they will be considered under the General (UR) category. Date of Birth and Name as recorded in the Matriculation/Secondary Examination Certificate (or equivalent) alone will be accepted, with no scope for later change.

CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026 Pay Scale

Post Pay Level (7th CPC)
Head Constable (GD) Sportspersons Level 4: Rs. 25,500 – 81,100
Constable (GD) Sportspersons Level 3: Rs. 21,700 – 69,100

Dearness Allowance, HRA and other allowances are admissible as per Government orders applicable in CRPF from time to time. The New Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (implemented vide MoF OM No. 1(7)(2)/2003/TA dated 07.01.2004) applies to selected candidates.

CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection proceeds through Identity Check, Documentation, Physical Standard Test (PST), Sports Trial Test, and Detailed/Review Medical Examination, in sequence.

1. Documentation

All candidates undergo document verification, producing original documents/certificates relating to age, education, sports achievement, domicile and category. Candidates unable to produce the prescribed originals are eliminated at this stage; those qualified proceed to the PST.

2. Marking of Achievements (Merit List Basis)

Marks are awarded for the single highest medal/position achieved during the eligible window (30 September 2024 to 30 September 2026); if a candidate has more than one medal, only the highest-scoring one counts. Sample marking tiers:

Competition Level Gold Silver Bronze Participation
Olympic Games (Summer/Winter) 100 96 92 80
World Championship/World Cup 90 86 82 70
Asian/Commonwealth Games 80 76 72 60
Asian/Commonwealth Championship or Cup 70 66 62 50
Youth Olympic Games 60 56 52 40
Youth/Junior World Championship or Cup 55 51 47 35
Youth/Junior Asian & Commonwealth Championship 50 46 42 30
SAF Games / recognized International Competition (min. 7 countries, backed by a National-level medal) 40 36 32 26
National Games/Senior National Championship – Individual medal 30 26 22 12
National Games/Senior National Championship – Team event 26 22 18 8
Youth/Junior National Championship/Inter-University/Khelo India – Individual medal 20 16 12 6
Youth/Junior National Championship/Inter-University/Khelo India – Team event 16 12 8 4

3. Physical Standard Test (PST)

Standard Male Female
Height 170 cm 157 cm
Chest (male only) 80 cm unexpanded, min. 5 cm expansion —
Weight Proportionate to height and age, as per medical standards

Height/chest relaxations are available for several categories, including Scheduled Tribes (162.5/150 cm), ST candidates of North-Eastern States (157/147.5 cm), ST candidates of Left-Wing Extremism-affected districts (160/147.5 cm), Garhwalis/Kumaonis/Dogras/Marathas and candidates from Assam, Himachal Pradesh, J&K and Ladakh (165/155 cm), candidates from the North-Eastern States of Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Tripura (162.5/152.5 cm), and candidates from the Gorkha Territorial Administration area of Darjeeling district (157/152.5 cm), with corresponding chest relaxations for male candidates in several of these categories.

4. Sports Trial Test

Candidates who qualify the PST undergo the Sports Trial Test, conducted by a Board of Officers. This test is purely qualifying (pass/fail) – no marks are awarded, and total marks for the merit list come only from the achievement marking scheme above. Candidates may be subjected to a Dope Test on the day of the trial; no appeal for re-conduct of the trial test is entertained.

5. Detailed Medical Examination (DME) & Review Medical Examination (RME)

Conducted per the Uniform Guidelines for Recruitment Medical Examination for GOs and NGOs in CAPFs and AR (MHA U.O. No. A.VI-1/2014-Rectt(SSB) dated 20.05.2015 and MHA OM No. E.32012/ADG(Med)/DME/RME/DA-1/2020(Part file)/1166 dated 31.05.2021, as amended). Minimum distance vision required is 6/6 and 6/9 in both eyes without correction; colour-blind candidates are not eligible; candidates must not have knock knee, flat foot, varicose veins or squint. Tattoos are restricted in content (secular/religious symbols only, as per Indian Army norms), location (left forearm inner aspect or dorsum of hands only) and size (less than ¼ of that body part). Candidates declared unfit in DME may undergo RME.

Order of Preference (for Merit)

Where marks are comparable, preference follows this order: (a) International representation with Department of Sports clearance; (b) Senior/Junior National Championship representation with a medal (Senior preferred over Junior); (c) Inter-University/Khelo India University Games medal; (d) Khelo India Youth/Winter Games medal; (e) School National Games medal; (f) participation at levels (b)–(e) without a medal, in the same order.

How to Apply for CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit rect.crpf.gov.in and read the instructions carefully before filling the application.
  2. Create your profile and upload a copy of the certificate/document for your sports discipline, in support of your highest medal/position or highest level of participation, before applying – applications without this upload will be rejected during scrutiny.
  3. Fill the online application form and pay the application fee (where applicable) through the website only.
  4. Submit the application before 11 November 2026, 23:59 hrs.
  5. Use the correction window (12–14 November 2026) if you need to modify your submitted application.
Important: The application must be submitted ONLINE only; no offline application is accepted, and candidature of anyone submitting offline will be summarily rejected. Candidates serving in Government/Semi-Government departments must submit their application through their employer along with a No Objection Certificate (as per Annexure-A format) – applications without an NOC will not be accepted.

Documents Required (Original, at Document Verification)

  • Educational certificates, Sports certificates, Domicile and Caste certificates, etc.
  • Matriculation/10th class certificate, for verification of Date of Birth
  • OBC (NCL) Certificate (Annexure-F), SC/ST Certificate (Annexure-G), or EWS Certificate valid for 2026-27 (Annexure-H), as applicable – certificates in any other format are not accepted
  • Undertaking for OBC (NCL) reservation claim, as per Annexure-F
  • No Objection Certificate (Annexure-B), for candidates serving in Government service, produced at the time of physical document verification
  • Certificate for claiming height/chest relaxation (Annexure-I), if applicable
  • Four latest passport-size photographs, matching the one submitted with the application form

Important Conditions

  • Application Fee: Male candidates belonging to UR/OBC/EWS pay Rs. 100/- through the recruitment website; the fee is exempted for all female candidates and for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen candidates. The fee is neither refunded nor adjusted against any other recruitment process, under any circumstances.
  • Selected candidates must submit a bond to serve the Force for a minimum of 3 years (or a specific period as prescribed), backed by an undertaking bond of Rs. 1,00,000/-, to promote sports in the Force, before they can resign for better employment elsewhere or on any other ground.
  • Posts carry All India service liability; selected candidates are liable to serve anywhere in India or abroad, and will be governed by the CRPF Act 1949 and Rules 1955.
  • CRPF reserves the right to modify, cancel, postpone, or reschedule any stage of the recruitment process, and to change the sequence of the recruitment procedure, without assigning any reason.
  • Submitting fabricated documents, or documents that have been tampered with, will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage, including at the time of document verification or later.
  • The Board of Officers may also recommend cases of Outstanding Sportspersons who show excellent trial performance but require some relaxation in height/chest/weight for their sport, subject to approval by the Ministry of Home Affairs.

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

Sarkari Bharat Vacancies by Sector

Sarkari bharat vacancies span several major recruiting sectors. Each sector below links to a dedicated hub page with sector-specific notifications, eligibility criteria, and exam patterns.

Banking Jobs (IBPS, SBI, RBI)

Banking recruitment includes IBPS PO, IBPS Clerk, SBI PO, SBI Clerk, RBI Assistant, and NABARD postings. These roles are among the most competitive sarkari bharat jobs, offering strong starting pay and clear promotion tracks. Browse current openings on our Banking Jobs hub.

Railway Jobs (RRB NTPC, ALP, Group D)

Indian Railways is the country's largest single recruiter, with RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP, JE, and Technician posts opening in large batches. Check live Railway vacancies on our Railway Jobs hub.

Defence Jobs (Army, Navy, Air Force)

Defence recruitment covers Indian Army (including Agniveer), Navy, Air Force, BSF, CRPF, CISF, and ITBP postings. See ongoing openings on our Defence Jobs hub.

Teaching Jobs (KVS, NVS, State Boards)

Teaching sarkari jobs include KVS, NVS, DSSSB, and state education board recruitment for TGT, PGT, and PRT posts. Explore current teaching vacancies on our Teaching Jobs hub.

SSC & UPSC Notifications

SSC (CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD) and UPSC (Civil Services, CDS, NDA) notifications remain the most closely tracked central-government exams. Full notification archives are available on our SSC Jobs and UPSC Jobs hubs.

Not every sarkari job requires a degree. Use the qualification and state filters below to sarkari job find openings that actually match your eligibility, instead of scrolling through listings you don't qualify for.

Several high-volume recruiters - including Railways (Group D), SSC (MTS, GD), and state police departments - recruit primarily at the 10th pass and 12th pass level. Browse these openings on our 10th & 12th Pass Jobs page.

Sarkari Job for Graduates & Postgraduates

Graduate and postgraduate-level sarkari jobs include SSC CGL, Bank PO, UPSC Civil Services, and various state PCS exams. See qualification-matched listings on our Graduate Jobs page.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

हर साल लाखों उम्मीदवार सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 भरने की प्रक्रिया में गलतियाँ कर बैठते हैं, जिससे उनका आवेदन रद्द हो सकता है। नीचे दी गई सरल प्रक्रिया से आप अपना फॉर्म सही तरीके से भर सकते हैं।

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job refers to any government job opportunity across India's central and state departments - including Railways, Banking, SSC, UPSC, Defence, Police, and PSUs - offering job security, fixed pay scales, and pension benefits under government service rules.

How can I get instant Sarkari Job Alert notifications?

You can bookmark this page for daily updates, or subscribe to OnlyJobs's notification service to receive a Sarkari Job Alert as soon as a new central or state vacancy is announced.

Where can I check the latest Bharat Job Result 2026?

All declared results - including written exam results, merit lists, and interview outcomes - are listed in the Results section of this page, updated as soon as departments release official Bharat Job Result notices.

How do I find a Sarkari Job that matches my qualification?

Use the qualification filters on this page to sarkari job find openings suited to 10th pass, 12th pass, diploma, graduate, or postgraduate candidates, sorted by sector and state.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 में आवेदन कैसे करें?

सबसे पहले संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना पढ़ें, पात्रता जांचें, फिर वैध ईमेल और मोबाइल नंबर से रजिस्ट्रेशन करके फॉर्म भरें, दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें और आवेदन शुल्क जमा करें।

Is OnlyJobs reliable for sarkarijob updates?

Yes - OnlyJobs has tracked sarkarijob notifications since 2011, cross-verifying every listing against official department websites before publishing.

What is the difference between a Sarkari Job and a private-sector job?

Sarkari jobs offer government-backed job security, pension (NPS/OPS), fixed working hours, and statutory benefits, while private jobs typically offer market-driven pay with fewer long-term security guarantees.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Forest Department Posts List

The forest department offers a range of posts across different levels, from ground-level field roles to gazetted officer positions. Most current openings on this page are for Group C posts - Forest Guard, Forester, Beat Guard, and Field Guard - making this a common landing point for anyone searching forest department group c recruitment 2026.

  • Forest Guard - entry-level field post responsible for forest protection and anti-poaching patrols
  • Forester - supervises Forest Guards and manages a forest beat or range sub-unit
  • Forest Beat Officer - field-level post combining patrol, record-keeping, and community liaison duties; commonly searched as forest beat officer notification 2026
  • Range Forest Officer (RFO) - manages an entire forest range, includes administrative and enforcement responsibilities
  • Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF) - gazetted officer post, typically recruited through state forest service exams
  • Indian Forest Service (IFS) Officer - recruited through UPSC, the highest field-level forestry cadre in India

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs 2026

Educational Qualification

  • Forest Guard / Forest Watcher / Field Guard: 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board
  • Forester: 12th pass, often with Science subjects; some states require a diploma in Forestry
  • Range Forest Officer: Graduate degree, frequently in Science, Agriculture, or Forestry
  • ACF / IFS: Graduate degree in a relevant discipline (Botany, Zoology, Forestry, Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Engineering, or Environmental Science), followed by the respective state or UPSC exam

Age Limit & Relaxation

The general age limit for Forest Guard and Forester posts is usually 18–27 years, though this varies by state. Age relaxation is generally available for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD candidates, and other reserved categories as per government norms.

Reservation & Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen

Most state forest departments reserve a fixed percentage of Forest Guard, Forester, and Beat Guard posts for ex-servicemen, in addition to SC, ST, OBC, and EWS reservations. Candidates applying for jobs for ex servicemen in forest department typically receive:

  • Additional age relaxation, usually 3–5 years beyond the general age cap (or as per length of military service)
  • Relaxed physical standards in several states
  • A reserved vacancy quota, separate from the general merit list

Exact quota percentages and relaxation norms differ by state, so always cross-check the specific notification before applying.

Physical Standards

Most Forest Guard and Forester posts require candidates to clear height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and a Physical Efficiency Test involving running, walking, or trekking - since the job involves regular field patrol duty in forest terrain.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern for Forest Officer & Forest Guard Posts

The selection process for forest department recruitment generally involves multiple stages, designed to test both academic knowledge and physical fitness given the field nature of the job.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  1. Written Examination - objective-type questions on General Knowledge, General Science, Reasoning, Mathematics, and sometimes Forestry/Environment-related topics
  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) / Physical Standard Test (PST) - running, walking/trekking distance, height and chest measurement
  3. Document Verification - verification of educational certificates, age proof, category certificates, and (where applicable) ex-servicemen discharge documents
  4. Medical Examination - fitness check before final appointment
  5. Final Merit List - based on combined written exam and PET/PST scores, as per each state's weightage formula

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs
  • General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology basics)
  • Basic Mathematics / Numerical Ability
  • Reasoning & Mental Ability
  • State-specific General Knowledge (local geography, forests, wildlife sanctuaries)
  • For Ranger/RFO level: Forestry science, environmental laws, and wildlife protection acts

The application last date varies by state and recruiting body - it is listed against each notification in the table above under "Last Date to Apply." Always confirm the exact date on the official notification before applying.

Q3: What is the qualification for forest guard recruitment 2026?

Most Forest Guard and Field Guard posts require a 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board. Higher posts like Forester or Range Forest Officer typically need 12th pass, a graduate degree, or a degree in a science/forestry-related field.

Q4: Is there any age relaxation for ex-servicemen in forest department recruitment?

Yes. Jobs for ex-servicemen in the forest department usually come with reserved vacancies and additional age relaxation - typically 3 to 5 years beyond the standard age limit - along with relaxed physical standards in many states.

Q5: How can I apply online for forest department vacancy 2026?

Visit the official website of the respective state forest department or recruitment board, register with your basic details, fill in the application form, upload the required documents, pay the fee, and submit. Full step-by-step details are in the "How to Apply" section above.

Q6: Which states have active forest guard recruitment 2026 notifications?

States including West Bengal, Punjab, Tamil Nadu, Himachal Pradesh, and Tripura currently have or regularly release forest guard and forest officer vacancies. See the state-wise section above for details on each.

Q7: What is the salary for forest guard and forest officer posts in 2026?

Forest Guard salary typically ranges from ₹28,000 to ₹35,000 gross per month under Pay Level 3, while Range Forest Officer and ACF posts range from ₹50,000 to ₹95,000 depending on pay level. Full breakdown is in the salary table above.

Q8: Is there a written exam for forest guard recruitment 2026?

Yes, most states conduct a written exam covering General Knowledge, General Science, Reasoning, and Mathematics, followed by a Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and document verification before the final merit list is prepared.

Two Types of No Exam Govt Jobs

No-exam recruitment in India falls into two patterns, and knowing which one a notification belongs to tells you exactly what to prepare for:

Type Typical Posts Who it's for How Selection Works
Fresher - no exam, usually no interview Apprentice, GDS, trainee 10th/12th/ITI/Diploma/Graduate pass Merit list prepared from academic marks
Experienced - no exam, interview-based Officer, manager, specialist, medical Professionals with relevant work experience Shortlisting based on qualification/experience, followed by a personal interview

How Recruitment Without Exam Works in Government Jobs

This section explains the different routes through which government departments fill vacancies without conducting a written competitive exam.

1. Direct Recruitment

Certain senior and specialised posts - such as Chairman, Member, and Secretary in Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and State Public Service Commissions (PSCs) - are filled through direct recruitment based on eligibility criteria like qualifications, experience, and domain expertise, rather than a written exam. Similarly, some administrative posts in the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) may be filled through direct recruitment.

2. Sports Quota Recruitment

Government organisations such as Indian Railways, the Indian Army, and Public Sector Banks reserve a quota of posts for candidates with outstanding achievements in sports at the state, national, or international level. Eligible candidates can be appointed to posts like Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, and Clerk without going through the regular written exam.

3. Cultural Quota Recruitment

Indian Railways also recruits individuals with exceptional talent in arts, fine arts, music, or literature under the cultural quota for posts such as Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, and Assistant Loco Pilot.

4. Internal Promotions and Deputation

Government departments, including the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and Indian Police Service (IPS), promote existing employees to higher posts based on performance, seniority, and experience - without requiring them to clear a fresh competitive exam. Ex-servicemen and defence personnel are also often considered for civilian government posts through deputation or reservation quotas, without a written exam.

5. Apprenticeships and Trainee Programmes

Railways, PSUs, and central organisations like DRDO and BEL regularly hire Act Apprentices, Trade Apprentices, and Project Trainees through merit lists based on academic marks - with no written entrance test.

6. Walk-in Interviews

Some government and PSU organisations directly call candidates for walk-in interviews based on their qualifications and experience, especially for technical, medical, and contractual roles.

Government Jobs Without Exam by Sector

This section breaks down no-exam opportunities by sector - banking and railways - which are among the most common areas where such recruitment occurs.

Bank Jobs Without Exam

While most public sector bank recruitment (PO, Clerk, SO) happens through IBPS or bank-specific written exams, some banks fill specific posts - such as Local Bank Officer and certain Specialist Officer roles - through direct recruitment, where the bank shortlists applications based on eligibility criteria and conducts an interview instead of a written test.

Railway Jobs Without Exam

Indian Railways and the various Railway Recruitment Boards/Cells (RRBs/RRCs) offer no-exam entry through:

  • Act Apprentices (selection via academic merit list)
  • Sports Quota posts (Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, Clerk)
  • Cultural Quota posts (Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, Assistant Loco Pilot)
  • Scouts and Guides Quota

Before You Apply: How to Spot Fake "No Exam" Job Offers

No-exam recruitment is the single biggest magnet for job fraud in India, because "direct joining, no exam" is exactly what scammers promise. Four rules protect you:

  1. No genuine government post is ever sold. Nobody - agent, "officer", consultancy - can arrange selection for money. The only payment in real recruitment is the application fee, paid on the official portal, typically a few hundred rupees.
  2. Verify the notification on the official domain. Every real notice lives on a .gov.in, .nic.in or official PSU domain. Every row in our list links to the post page where the official notification PDF and apply link are attached - if an offer you received isn't traceable to an official notice, treat it as fraud.
  3. No recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram DMs. Forwarded "joining letters" and interview calls demanding a deposit are scams, full stop.
  4. Cross-check suspicious notices against PIB Fact Check before sharing or paying anything.

How to Apply for Government Jobs Without Exam

  1. Open the post from the live list and read the official notification PDF - eligibility, age limits and fee are final there, not in any summary.
  2. Confirm you match the qualification and category requirements before paying any fee.
  3. Apply on the official portal linked in the notification; keep the registration number and fee receipt.
  4. For merit-list posts (GDS, apprentice), enter marks exactly as on your certificates - mismatches reject applications at verification.
  5. Track the post page for merit list / shortlist updates, or subscribe to WhatsApp/Telegram alerts so deadlines and results reach you automatically.

Government Jobs Without Exam - FAQs

1. Are there really government jobs without an exam?

Yes. Apprenticeship intakes, India Post GDS, sports and cultural quota posts, walk-in interviews and direct recruitment for experienced candidates are all filled without a written competitive exam. The live list at the top of this page shows every such notification currently open.

2. Which government jobs have no exam and no interview at all?

India Post GDS and Railway/PSU Act Apprentice selections use only a merit list of academic marks - there is no written test and no interview. Everything depends on your Class 10 (and ITI/diploma, where applicable) percentage.

3. What no-exam options exist for freshers after 10th, 12th or ITI?

Apprenticeships, GDS and trainee posts are the main fresher routes. Selection is a merit list prepared from academic marks, which is why these notifications attract very high application volumes despite no exam.

4. Can experienced professionals get a government job without an exam?

Yes. PSUs and autonomous bodies fill officer, manager and specialist posts by shortlisting candidates on qualification and experience, followed by a personal interview - no written test.

5. Are government jobs without exam permanent?

Often not. Apprenticeships are roughly one-year training engagements with a stipend, and many walk-in posts are contractual with fixed tenure. Direct-recruitment posts can be regular - the notification states the nature of each post, so check before applying.

6. Are there bank jobs without an exam?

A few. Some banks fill specialist and local officer posts through shortlisting plus interview. Bank apprenticeship drives vary - some are merit-based while others include an online test - so read each notification's selection clause.

7. Are there railway jobs without an exam?

Yes: Act Apprentice intakes (merit list), sports quota, cultural quota and Scouts & Guides quota. Apprentice intakes are large; the quota routes are small zonal recruitments with their own assessment process.

8. Is India Post GDS really without an exam?

Yes - selection is an online merit list generated from Class 10 marks, with no exam and no interview. Because of that, GDS is heavily targeted by paid-selection scams; apply only through the official GDS portal.

9. How do I identify fake "no exam" job offers?

No genuine government post is sold, fees are paid only on official portals, and no recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram messages. Verify every offer against the official notification on a government or PSU domain - if it isn't there, it's fraud.

10. How often is this list updated?

Daily. New notifications are added as they release, and every listing is removed automatically after its last date, so the list only ever shows posts you can still apply for.

Govt Jobs for Law Graduates - Eligibility (LLB, LLM, BL)

Eligibility varies by post, but the core requirement for almost every government law job is a recognised law degree. Senior and specialised roles add experience, an LLM, or Bar enrolment on top.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor of Law (BL) / LLB (Legum Baccalaureus): the baseline qualification for most legal and law officer posts.
  • LLM (Master of Laws): required for senior legal officer, faculty, and some advisory positions.
  • Integrated 5-year degrees - BA LLB, BBA LLB, BCom LLB - are accepted wherever an LLB is required.

The degree must be from a university recognised by the Bar Council of India.

Bar Council Enrolment & AIBE

For litigation, prosecutor, and standing-counsel roles you generally need to be enrolled as an advocate with a State Bar Council, and many positions ask for the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) Certificate of Practice issued by the Bar Council of India. Purely advisory or research posts (Law Clerk, Research Fellow, Legal Consultant) often do not require enrolment.

Age Limit & Relaxations

The upper age limit is typically 30 to 40 years for the general category, depending on the post and recruiter. Statutory relaxations apply: usually 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, and additional relaxation for PwD and ex-servicemen candidates. Always confirm the exact limit and cut-off date in the official notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Salary & Pay Scale for Government Law Jobs

Pay depends on the organisation and grade. Officer-level legal posts under the 7th Pay Commission generally fall in Pay Levels 10 to 12, with a monthly salary roughly between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500, plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, and other benefits. PSU legal officers are paid on IDA scales, which can be higher at entry grade.

Types of Law Officer / Legal Posts in Government Sector

  • Judicial Services - Civil Judge (Junior Division), Additional District Judge, High Court Judge, recruited via State Judicial Service Exams (PCS-J)
  • Law Officer / Legal Officer - Roles in public sector banks (IBPS SO Law), insurance companies (LIC AAO Legal), regulatory bodies (SEBI Grade A Legal), and PSUs (Coal India, NTPC, GAIL Legal)
  • Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor - Administrative legal support roles in ministries, universities, and district courts
  • Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO) - Prosecution roles recruited through State PSCs, requiring LLB and often a minimum years of practice

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, ADJ, High Court Judge)

Judicial Services is the most prestigious and highest-paying career path for LLB graduates. Recruitment happens through State Public Service Commissions (e.g., RPSC, UPPSC, MPPSC) via a three-stage exam: Preliminary, Mains, and Interview. Civil Judge posts typically require 0-3 years of practice depending on the state, while some states allow fresh LLB graduates to apply directly.

Law Officer / Legal Officer (Banks, PSU, Insurance)

Public sector banks and insurance companies recruit Law Officers through specialist officer (SO) exams. These posts require only an LLB degree (AIBE not mandatory) and offer competitive pay scales under the 7th Pay Commission equivalent structure, along with allowances.

Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor Posts

These are typically Group B/C administrative-legal posts in ministries, universities, and PSU legal departments, requiring an LLB degree and sometimes relevant drafting/litigation experience.

Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO)

APO recruitment is conducted by State PSCs (e.g., RPSC Assistant Prosecution Officer) and requires an LLB degree, enrollment as an advocate, and in most states, a minimum period of practice (often 3 years).
