Selection Process for Law Govt Jobs

The selection process differs by post but commonly includes:

  1. Written examination - testing legal knowledge, aptitude, and general awareness (for judicial services and most exam-based posts).
  2. Interview / viva-voce - assessing legal reasoning and suitability.
  3. Document verification - degree, Bar enrolment, AIBE, age, and category certificates.

Advisory and consultant posts are often filled by shortlisting and interview alone, without a written exam.

Law Govt Jobs FAQ's

What are the latest law govt jobs in 2026?

Current law government jobs in 2026 include Law Officer, Legal Officer, Assistant Prosecution Officer, Judicial Service, and Legal Adviser posts across High Courts, PSUs, public sector banks, and central/state departments. The table above is updated daily with vacancy count, last date, and the official notification link.

Which departments hire LLB and law graduates?

High Courts and District Courts, the Ministry of Law and Justice, UPSC, State Public Service Commissions, public sector banks, PSUs, insurance companies, and regulatory bodies regularly recruit law graduates for legal and judicial roles.

What is the eligibility for government law jobs?

Most posts require a Bachelor of Law (LLB/BL) from a recognised university; senior roles may require LLM and experience. Litigation and prosecutor posts usually require enrolment with a State Bar Council and, often, the AIBE certificate.

What is the salary of a Law Officer in the government sector?

A government Law Officer or Legal Officer typically earns between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500 per month under the 7th Pay Commission, depending on the organisation, plus DA, HRA, and allowances. PSU legal officers draw IDA-scale pay.

Can a fresher LLB graduate get a government job?

Yes. Freshers can apply for Civil Judge (Junior Division) judicial-service exams, Law Clerk and Research Fellow posts in High Courts, and trainee legal roles. Some PSU and bank Law Officer posts require a few years of post-enrolment experience.

How can I apply for law officer vacancies in central government?

Open the post in the table above, read the official notification, register on the recruiter's portal, fill in the application with your LLB and enrolment details, pay the fee, and submit before the last date.

What is the difference between Judicial Services and Law Officer posts

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, via state judiciary exams) places you on the bench as a judge. Law Officer/Legal Officer posts are departmental legal-counsel roles in PSUs, banks, and ministries - advisory and litigation support, recruited by interview or written test.

Is there an age limit for govt law jobs?

Most posts set the upper age at 30 to 40 years for the general category, with statutory relaxations for OBC, SC/ST, and PwD candidates. Check each notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Vacancy 2026

NABFINS has announced an opportunity for the post of Customer Service Officer. The CSO works closely with the branch team and plays an important role in customer sourcing, portfolio growth, verification, field operations, disbursement support and recovery.

The number of vacancies has not been specified in the details provided for this recruitment.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Job Role

The primary responsibility of a Customer Service Officer is to source customers and increase the sustainable portfolio of the branch.

The CSO has to identify new business locations, source potential customers and support their addition to the branch portfolio. After disbursement, the employee is also responsible for following up with customers and collecting installments on scheduled dates.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Responsibilities

The key responsibilities of a NABFINS Customer Service Officer include:

  • Sourcing of clients.
  • Primary verification of client credentials.
  • Conducting Compulsory Group Training.
  • Data entry in CRIF.
  • Data entry in CMS.
  • Accompanying the Branch Manager for Group Recognition Test.
  • Accompanying CSE during pre-disbursement activities.
  • Ensuring disbursement.
  • Generating demand.
  • Following up for recovery and undertaking collections.
  • Remitting collections in the bank or banks.
  • Reporting demand and collection details to ABM/BM.
  • Maintaining and filing documents.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates applying for the NABFINS Customer Service Officer Recruitment 2026 must meet the prescribed educational, language and field mobility requirements.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Qualification

The minimum educational qualification is:

PUC/10+2 completed.

Candidates who have completed Higher Secondary or an equivalent 10+2 qualification can apply, subject to the other eligibility requirements.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Language Requirement

Applicants must have written, spoken and reading command over the local language and English.

This requirement is important because the role involves regular interaction with customers, branch staff and field-level operations.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Experience

Freshers are eligible to apply for the Customer Service Officer post.

However, candidates with 1 to 3 years of experience in a similar job profile and sufficient exposure to field operations and the target customer population may be preferred.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Driving Licence Requirement

A valid driving licence and motorcycle are mandatory for the Customer Service Officer role.

The job involves field visits, identifying new business locations, customer sourcing, collection and other branch-related field activities.

Shortlisted candidates should follow further instructions communicated by NABFINS regarding the next stages of recruitment.

This Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 covers a total of 8 posts across Deputy Manager (Grade/Scale JM I – Banking Operations) and Manager (Grade/Scale MM II – Internal Audit), against SC, ST, and OBC backlog vacancies. Exim Bank Deputy Manager & Manager Vacancy 2026

A total of 8 vacancies have been notified under this Special Recruitment Drive for backlog posts, as shown below. Reservations are applicable as per prevailing Government of India guidelines, and the reservation for PwBD candidates is on a horizontal basis for Hearing Impairment (HI) disability.

Exim Bank Deputy Manager & Manager Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility (age, educational qualification, etc.) is computed as on 31-08-2026, as detailed below for each post.

Manager (Grade/Scale MM II) – Internal Audit (2 Posts)

Qualification: Minimum 50% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA in Graduation (minimum 3-year full-time course), AND Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade, or Chartered Accountant (CA). The Post Graduation course should be a minimum 2-year full-time duration with a specialization in Finance and minimum 50% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA. For CA, passing the professional examination is sufficient, and membership of ICAI is mandatory.

Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in a scheduled commercial bank, an all-India financial institution, or another organization of repute, in internal audit / credit audit, including handling preparation and submission of reports by internal/concurrent auditors, audit compliance, analysis and timely submission of audit observations to the audit committee, review of internal/concurrent audit scope and systems/procedures/controls, and experience dealing with RBI on audit/inspection matters (in Scale I or equivalent).

Deputy Manager (Grade/Scale JM I) – Banking Operations (6 Posts)

Qualification: Minimum 50% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA in Graduation (minimum 3-year full-time course), AND Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade, or Chartered Accountant (CA), on the same terms as above.

Experience (as on 31-08-2026): Minimum 1 year of post-qualification (Post Graduation or CA) work experience in a reputed commercial bank / financial institution / state level term lending institution, with skills in project finance, credit appraisal, term lending, analysis of cross-border risks, and financing of overseas joint ventures.

Other Eligibility Notes

  • Candidates should possess excellent communication skills and be proficient in computers and information technology.
  • Candidates from universities awarding CGPA/GPA instead of numerical marks must furnish a conversion letter from the head of the institute / controller of examination if the equivalent percentage is not mentioned on the marksheet.
  • The university/institute must be recognised/approved by the Government / AICTE / UGC.
  • Candidates who completed graduation or post-graduation through correspondence / part-time / open university / open learning / external / distance / e-learning are not eligible.

Exim Bank Deputy Manager & Manager Selection Process

Selection comprises a Written Test followed by a Personal Interview.

Structure of Written Test

Name of Test Section No. of Questions Max. Marks Time
Professional Knowledge – Subjective Part I – Question 1 (Compulsory) 1 40 2 hours 30 minutes
Part II – Attempt any 6 out of 8 Questions 6 (of 8) 60
Total 100 2 hours 30 minutes

There is no sectional cut-off; the final list for interviews is drawn based on the candidate's overall performance in the written test. Final selection is based on combined performance in the Written Examination (out of 100, with 70% weightage) and the Interview (out of 100, with 30% weightage). A pre-recruitment training will be organised for candidates from reserved categories who opt for it through the online application form.

How to Apply for Exim Bank Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online only, from 15 September 2026 to 10 October 2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.

  1. Visit the Bank's Online Application page and click "APPLY ONLINE."
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details, and Email ID. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated and also sent via email/SMS.
  3. Fill in the application form; use "SAVE AND NEXT" to save progress before final submission, since no changes are possible after clicking "COMPLETE REGISTRATION."
  4. Upload your Photograph, Signature, Left Thumb Impression, and Handwritten Declaration as per the prescribed specifications.
  5. Fill in remaining details, preview the application, and click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" only after verifying all details.
  6. Proceed to the "Payment" tab and complete the online fee payment, then click "Submit."
  7. Take a printout of the e-Receipt and the completed online application form for future reference.

Note: Candidates can apply for only one post. If a candidate applies for more than one post, only the latest valid (completed) application/registration will be retained, and fees paid for other registrations will stand forfeited.

Photograph 4.5cm × 3.5cm, colour, white/light background, 200×230 pixels, 20–50 KB, JPG/JPEG

  • Candidates should be willing to serve anywhere in India; selected candidates may also be transferred to offices outside India with their consent.
  • OBC caste certificates must specifically contain the non-creamy layer clause and must be valid (issued within one year prior to) the last date of applying.
  • Deputy Managers must execute a personal bond of ₹3 lakhs to serve the Bank for a minimum of 5 years from the date of joining.
  • Candidates who have defaulted on loan repayment or appear in the CIBIL defaulter database are not eligible to join the Bank.
  • Selected candidates already in service must produce a proper relieving letter/discharge certificate in original at the time of joining.
  • Any legal proceedings related to this advertisement can be instituted only in Mumbai, with courts/tribunals in Mumbai having sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • The Bank reserves the right to cancel, restrict, curtail, or enlarge the recruitment process, including the number of vacancies, at any stage without notice.
  • Candidates whose writing speed is permanently affected may use a scribe at their own cost and arrangement, subject to the Bank's stipulated scribe guidelines, and will be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of examination if registered for it in advance.

Action against misconduct: Candidates found using unfair means, impersonation, misbehaviour in the examination/interview hall, disclosing or transmitting exam content, carrying mobile phones/electronic devices into the hall, or providing false information may be disqualified from the examination, debarred from future Bank examinations, or, if already employed, have their service terminated - in addition to being liable for criminal prosecution.

Bank of India (BOI), a leading Public Sector Bank with its Head Office in Mumbai, has released a notification for the recruitment of Officers in various Specialist streams up to Scale IV. Under Project No. 2026-27/02 dated 01.08.2026, BOI is inviting applications for 205 vacancies across 48 distinct posts ranging from Officer (Scale I) to Chief Manager (Scale IV). Candidates with qualifications in Computer Science/IT, Law, Fire Engineering, and Civil Engineering can apply online between 10.09.2026 and 25.09.2026.

In brief: BOI is recruiting for IT and specialist officer roles spanning Full-Stack Engineering, Digital Platforms, Information Security, DevSecOps, Data Engineering, Database Administration, Law Officer, Fire Officer, Security Officer, and Civil Engineer, among others. Eligible Indian citizens (and other nationalities specified in the notice) meeting the post-specific qualification and experience criteria as on 01.08.2026 can apply online through the official BOI website. The application mode is online only, and postings will be anywhere in India.

How to Apply for Bank of India Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official website www.bankofindia.bank.in and click on 'CAREER'
  2. Click the link "Recruitment of Officers in various streams upto Scale IV – Project No. 2026-27/02 Notice dated 01.08.2026"
  3. Click 'APPLY ONLINE' and complete new registration to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password
  4. Fill in personal, educational, and experience details; upload photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and hand-written declaration as per specifications
  5. Preview and verify all details before clicking 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION'
  6. Pay the application fee/intimation charges online
  7. Take a printout of the system-generated application form and e-receipt for personal record

📄 Complete Details & Notification

Bank of Baroda (BoB), one of India's largest public sector banks, has released the Bank of Baroda Recruitment 2026 notification (Advt No. BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/17) for the regular-basis recruitment of Wealth Executive and Credit Analyst – C&IC (Corporate & Institutional Credit) posts. A total of 1,100 vacancies are on offer - 1,000 posts for Wealth Executive (JMG/S-I) under the Wealth Management Services department and 100 posts for Credit Analyst-C&IC (MMG/S-II) under the Corporate & Institutional Credit department. Online registration for Bank of Baroda Wealth Executive and Credit Analyst Recruitment 2026 starts on 04.09.2026 and closes on 24.09.2026. Eligible candidates can apply online through the bank's official website.

In short: Bank of Baroda is recruiting for Wealth Executive and Credit Analyst-C&IC posts, with 1,100 total vacancies (1,000 + 100). Graduates with the relevant certification/professional qualification and requisite experience, who are willing to serve anywhere in India, can apply. Applications open 04.09.2026 and close 24.09.2026, applications are accepted only in online mode, and selected candidates may be posted to any branch or office of the Bank across India.

Bank of Baroda Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF Out

Bank of Baroda has released the official notification PDF for Wealth Executive and Credit Analyst-C&IC Recruitment 2026 on its careers page. Candidates are advised to read the full notification carefully before applying.

  • Notification PDF: Advt No. BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/17
  • Apply Online Link: Apply Here
  • Official Website: Check Here
  • • Never Miss an Update from OnlyJobs – Save Us as a Preferred Source on Google

Bank of Baroda Recruitment 2026 Overview

Particulars Details
Recruiting Organisation Bank of Baroda (BoB)
Advertisement Number BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/17
Posts Wealth Executive, Credit Analyst – C&IC
Total Vacancies 1,100 (1,000 + 100)
Application Mode Online
Application Start Date 04.09.2026
Application Last Date 24.09.2026
Eligibility Cut-Off Date 01.09.2026
Job Location Anywhere in India (candidate must be willing to serve anywhere)
Official Website www.bankofbaroda.bank.in

Bank of Baroda Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
Online Registration Start Date 04.09.2026
Last Date for Submission of Application & Payment of Fees 24.09.2026
Eligibility Cut-Off Date 01.09.2026
Online Test Date Not specified in the notification (to be advised separately)

Also Read: SBI SCO Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 207 Specialist Cadre Officers Posts

Bank of Baroda Vacancy 2026 – Post Details

Bank of Baroda has announced 1,100 vacancies across two posts. The bank reserves the right to modify the number of vacancies depending on its requirement.

S. No. Post Name No. of Posts
1 Wealth Executive (JMG/S-I) – Wealth Management Services 1000 (SC-150, ST-75, OBC-270, EWS-100, UR-405)
2 Credit Analyst – C&IC (MMG/S-II) – Corporate & Institutional Credit 100 (SC-15, ST-8, OBC-27, EWS-10, UR-40)

Bank of Baroda Wealth Executive & Credit Analyst Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility for both posts is assessed as on the cut-off date, 01.09.2026. Candidates must fulfil the mandatory qualification, experience, and age criteria specified below for the post they are applying for.

Educational Qualification

Post Qualification Post-Qualification Experience
Wealth Executive Graduation in any discipline AND any one valid certification among: IC 38 (Insurance Institute of India), NISM Series V A (Mutual Fund Distributors), NISM Series XXI-A (PMS Distributors), or NISM Series V-D (Mutual Fund – Specialised Investment Fund Distributors). Preferred: 2-year full-time PG degree/diploma in Management or MBA (Finance/Marketing/Banking). Minimum 2 years of experience in sales of wealth products with leading public/private/foreign banks, broking, securities firms, asset management companies, or wealth management companies in India.
Credit Analyst – C&IC Graduation in any discipline AND Chartered Accountant. Mandatory: minimum 1 year of banking experience in a Scheduled Commercial Bank. Preferred: experience in Corporate Credit.

Note: Post-qualification experience of less than six months in any organisation as on 01.09.2026 will not be considered for eligibility, except when it is part of current employment. Experience in clerical cadre is not considered for determining eligibility. Educational qualifications must be from a college/institution/university recognised by the Government of India/Government bodies/AICTE.

Bank of Baroda Age Limit

Age is reckoned as on the cut-off date, 01.09.2026.

Post Minimum Age Maximum Age
Wealth Executive 22 years 32 years
Credit Analyst – C&IC 21 years 33 years

Maximum age indicated above is for General category candidates. Age relaxation is available as per the table below.

Category Age Relaxation
Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe 5 years
Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities Gen/EWS – 10 years, OBC – 13 years, SC/ST – 15 years
Ex-Servicemen / Commissioned Officers (incl. ECOs/SSCOs, min. 5 years military service) Gen/EWS – 5 years, OBC – 8 years, SC/ST – 10 years

Note: There is no reservation for Ex-Servicemen in the Officers' cadre. Candidates seeking age relaxation must submit the necessary certificates at the time of interview and any subsequent stage as required by the Bank.

Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

Bank of Baroda Reservation / Roster Points 2026

Reservation is applicable wherever applicable as per Government of India norms. The category-wise breakup, including horizontal reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), is given below.

Position SC ST OBC EWS UR Total PwBD (out of total)
Wealth Executive 150 75 270 100 405 1000 40 (LD-10, HI-10, VI-10, d&e*-10)
Credit Analyst – C&IC 15 8 27 10 40 100 4 (LD-1, HI-1, VI-1, d&e*-1)

Abbreviations: SC – Scheduled Castes; ST – Scheduled Tribes; OBC – Other Backward Classes; EWS – Economically Weaker Section; UR – Unreserved/General; PwBD – Persons with Benchmark Disabilities; LD – Locomotor Disability; HI – Hearing Impaired; VI – Visually Impaired. Candidates belonging to OBC "creamy layer" or whose caste is not in the Central List are not entitled to OBC reservation and must indicate category as "General." Change of category is not permitted after registration of the online application.

Bank of Baroda Wealth Executive & Credit Analyst Salary 2026

Selected candidates will be placed in the following pay scales, as amended from time to time. Salary and other emoluments are governed by the industry-level bipartite settlement and Joint Note applicable to officers in the banking sector, along with bank-specific allowances and perquisites.

Grade / Scale Pay Scale
JMG/S-I (Wealth Executive) 48480–2000/7–62480–2340/2–67160–2680/7–85920
MMG/S-II (Credit Analyst – C&IC) 64820–2340/1–67160–2680/10–93960

Bank of Baroda Application Fee 2026

The non-refundable application fee/intimation charges must be paid online, irrespective of whether the online test is conducted and irrespective of shortlisting outcome.

Category Fee (Inclusive of GST)
General, EWS & OBC Rs. 850/- + Payment Gateway Charges
SC, ST, PWBD, ESM (Ex-Servicemen) & Women Rs. 175/- + Payment Gateway Charges

Payment can be made using Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI. Transaction charges, if any, are borne by the candidate.

Bank of Baroda Selection Process 2026

The selection process may comprise Application Scrutiny, an Online Test, Psychometric Test, Group Discussion (GD) and/or Personal Interview (PI), or any other test deemed suitable by the Bank.

Online Test Structure (Tentative, if Conducted)

Section Name of Test No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration Version
1 English Language 20 20 20 Minutes English
2 Reasoning Ability & Quantitative Aptitude 20 20 20 Minutes Bilingual
3 General / Economic & Banking Awareness 20 20 20 Minutes Bilingual
4 Professional Knowledge related to the Position 60 60 60 Minutes Bilingual
Total   120 120 120 Minutes  
  • Sections 1, 2 and 3 are qualifying in nature; marks in these sections are not reckoned for the merit list.
  • There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer; no penalty for unattempted questions.
  • The minimum qualifying marks/percentage for Personal Interview (PI) is 60% for General & EWS category and 55% for other Reserved categories; the Bank reserves the right to change this at its discretion.
  • Candidates not clearing the PI will not be considered for final selection.
  • A Psychometric Test and/or PI assesses personality, communication, problem-solving, efficiency, and willingness to work anywhere in the country.
  • The Bank's shortlisting criteria are internal and confidential and are not shared with candidates.

Also Read: IBPS RRB CRP-XV Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 13706 Officer & Office Assistant Posts

Probation Period & Service Bond

  • Selected candidates will be on probation for a period of 12 months (1 year) of active service from the date of joining.
  • JMG/S-I officers: must serve a minimum of 3 years, or pay an amount equal to three months' gross salary (not exceeding Rs. 2 lakh) if they leave before completing 3 years.
  • MMG/S-II officers: must serve a minimum of 3 years, or pay an amount equal to three months' gross salary (not exceeding Rs. 3 lakh) if they leave before completing 3 years.

Documents Required

Candidates must produce the following documents in original with self-attested photocopies at the time of interview/any subsequent stage:

  • Printout of the valid GD/Interview Call Letter
  • Valid system-generated printout of the online application form
  • Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Std. X Certificate with DOB)
  • Photo Identity Proof (PAN Card/Passport/Driving License/Voter's Card/Aadhaar with photograph, etc. - Ration Card is NOT accepted)
  • Individual semester/year-wise mark sheets and certificates for educational qualifications, including the final degree/diploma certificate
  • Caste Certificate (for SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates) in the prescribed Government of India format
  • Disability Certificate in the prescribed format (for PwBD candidates)
  • Service/Discharge Book, pension payment order, and rank proof (for Ex-Servicemen)
  • No Objection Certificate (for candidates serving in Government/Quasi-Government offices or PSUs)
  • Certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India (for specified categories under nationality clause)
  • Relevant documents supporting declared work experience (appointment letter, salary slip, relieving letter, experience certificate)

How to Apply for Bank of Baroda Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official Bank of Baroda website: www.bankofbaroda.bank.in/Career.htm
  2. Navigate to Career section/web page > Current Opportunities and register online in the appropriate application format.
  3. Fill in the online application with accurate personal, educational, and category details. No change is permitted after clicking Submit.
  4. Upload the required documents: Resume, DOB proof, educational certificates, work experience certificates, caste/category certificate, and PwBD certificate (as applicable) - each in PDF format, page size A4, file size not exceeding 500 KB.
  5. Upload scanned photograph (200x230 pixels, 20–50 KB) and signature (140x60 pixels, 10–20 KB) as per the specifications in the notification.
  6. Upload left thumb impression image and hand-written declaration image as specified.
  7. Pay the application fee/intimation charges online using Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI.
  8. On successful payment, print and retain the system-generated e-receipt and application form for future reference.

Important Instructions

  • Only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India should apply.
  • Not more than one application should be submitted; in case of multiple applications, only the latest valid (complete) application is retained.
  • Short-listing and interview/selection is purely provisional without verification of documents; candidature is subject to verification of all details/documents with originals when called by the Bank.
  • No request for change of centre, venue, date, or time for examination/interview will be entertained.
  • All correspondence, including call letters and interview advices, will be sent only to the email ID registered in the online application form.
  • Any legal proceedings related to this recruitment can be instituted only in Mumbai, and courts/tribunals in Mumbai alone have jurisdiction.
  • Candidates should regularly check the Bank's official website for updates, corrigenda, and revisions, as no separate communication will be sent to non-shortlisted candidates.

When Is the RRB ALP Exam in 2026?

The RRB ALP CBT-1 exam is tentatively scheduled from 03/11/2026 to 05/11/2026. The notice calls this a tentative schedule, so the date, shift and centre that apply to you will be the ones shown in your exam city intimation and e-call letter. How to Check RRB ALP Exam City and Download the E-Call Letter

  1. Open the official website of the RRB you applied to (the list is given under Important Links below).
  2. Find the link for CEN 01/2026 Assistant Loco Pilot exam city and date.
  3. Log in with your candidate credentials. Keep your Registration Number handy, as the CEN advises candidates to note it for later stages. The notice does not list the exact login fields.
  4. Check your exam city and date. SC/ST candidates who opted for free travel can download the Travel Authority here.
  5. About 4 days before your exam date, return to the same website and download the e-call letter.
  6. Print the e-call letter. RRBs do not send call letters by post.

Important Instructions for the RRB ALP Exam

  • Aadhaar biometric authentication: Aadhaar-linked biometric authentication will be done at the exam centre before entry to the exam hall.
  • Verify Aadhaar in advance: candidates who have not authenticated their identity through Aadhaar should do so by logging in at www.rrbapply.gov.in, so that entry to the centre is smooth.
  • Keep Aadhaar unlocked: even candidates who verified Aadhaar during the application should make sure it remains unlocked in the UIDAI system before the exam day.
  • Update Aadhaar details: the Aadhaar card should show the correct name, date of birth (as per the Class 10 certificate), latest photograph, address and father's name.
  • No change of centre, date or shift: the CEN does not allow any request to change the exam date, centre or shift. Candidates may have to travel to another city or state.
  • Banned items: mobile phones, watches, earphones, Bluetooth devices, calculators, books, papers, bags, wallets, water bottles, food items and similar articles are not allowed inside the centre. A cloak room may not be available, so avoid carrying valuables.
  • Avoid henna: applying henna on hands or feet can obstruct biometric capture.
  • Self-declaration: candidates must write the self-declaration paragraph, sign it and affix the left thumb impression on the e-call letter at the exam hall, in front of the invigilator. Writing it in advance or signing in capital letters leads to rejection.
  • Trust only official sources: refer only to the official RRB websites for updates. RRBs do not appoint agents or coaching centres, and selection is based on merit in the CBT stages.

Documents to Carry on the Exam Day

  • Printed e-call letter
  • Original Aadhaar card or a printout of e-verified Aadhaar, as asked in the notice
  • Original photo ID as instructed on the e-call letter (the CEN lists ID types such as Voter ID, Aadhaar, driving licence, PAN card and passport)
  • A recent colour passport-size photograph, not older than two months from the exam date
  • For SC/ST candidates travelling on the free travel facility: the original community certificate and an original photo ID during the journey, and a self-attested photocopy of the e-call letter and SC/ST certificate while booking the ticket

How to Check the MPESB AEO Answer Key 2026

How to Calculate Your Score Using the Answer Key

  1. Note down your responses and compare each one with the answer key.
  2. Count the correct, wrong and unattempted questions.
  3. Add the marks for correct answers as given in the official marking scheme.
  4. Deduct 0.25 marks for each wrong answer, the negative marking reported for this exam.

Estimated score = (Correct answers × marks per correct answer) − (Wrong answers × 0.25). The marks per correct answer are not confirmed in the sources checked, so verify them in the official notification. Since the first key is provisional, your final score may change if the Board revises any answer.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Use only the official exam portal and esb.mp.gov.in to view the answer key and raise objections.

  • Keep your date of birth in DDMMYYYY format and your application details ready before logging in.
  • Save the acknowledgement of every objection you submit.
  • The first answer key is provisional, and the Board may revise it after objections.
  • Check the Board's notices regularly for the final answer key and result.
